Look at the Chunks tab: with sentence splitting, how many chunks does one call become?
Without overlap, a promise is whole only when it happens to fall inside one window. Bigger windows cut fewer promises but cost more tokens.
A promise is whole somewhere when the windows overlap by at least its length, about 145 characters at most.
Each window moves forward by chunk size minus overlap. If that step is small, the index fills up: keep it at about 150 characters or more, with a chunk size near 300.
